incised linear detail covering the surface
justification: A depicts a figural scene: a seated bearded figure raising a bowl, faced by a standing attendant with a staff, both with patterned garments and a footstool/throne, while B shows only a dense field of repeated wedge-like script signs in ruled rows with no figures, animals or objects at all. The only correspondence is that both are shallow incised/relief surfaces densely covered with fine linear marks, which is a generic technical similarity rather than shared iconography; script and figural scene could in principle belong to one tradition, but nothing depicted in B confirms it.
